In basic vanilla XL,

without string package ((LISP) STRING) loaded:

(EQUAL "ASDF" "ASDF") --> NIL
(ALPHALESSP 'A "B")   --> T

With string package loaded:

(EQUAL "ASDF" "ASDF") --> T
(ALPHALESSP 'A "B")   --> NIL

I really think that these should return T in all four cases...
